revision_note: The harbor drivers, adapters and scorer comparators were developed across two private lines that have diverged: the Science-Vision monorepo carries them under scripts/harbor/, harbor_adapters/ and sci3d_bench/scorers/, while the eval-baseline line of BabyVision-v2 carries the continuous September-October work and the isolated scorer_bundle. The commit above pins the line the reported results were produced on, and at that revision the source declares Apache-2.0. That revision is vendored here under the MIT license; later scorer fixes from either line are not included.
validation_note: The upstream pull request reports scorer self-consistency checks. They are not model benchmark results and were not rerun for this repository.
